entities.summary: In March 1742, during the Russo-Swedish War of 1741–1743, Empress Elizabeth of Russia issued a manifesto addressed to the people of Finland, at the time part of the Kingdom of Sweden. The manifesto promised peace and protection if Finns refrained from supporting the Swedish army. It also suggested that Finland could break away from Swedish rule and establish an autonomous government under Russian protection.
